EVIDENCE BEFORE RELEASE

Safe Preview

Safe Preview workflow for coding agents. Use when a requested operation may delete or overwrite data.

Workflow

  1. Identify the requested outcome and supplied evidence.
  2. List the exact target and preview consequences before irreversible execution.
  3. Verify the output contract and preserve uncertainty.

Populated example

Request: Delete ignored and untracked files.

Inspect git clean -ndx output and identify files at risk before deletion.

Use the helper

destructive_preview

Source: skills/safe-preview/SKILL.md in the package. Use this workflow selectively; it does not override user or system instructions.
